answer.reason: The verses tell of events at Bethel: God appearing to Jacob, Jeroboam's calf, and Josiah's breaking down of the altar.

clauses.english: was where Jacob built an altar after God appeared to him
was where Jeroboam set up a golden calf for worship
clauses.quote: And he set the one in Bethel

clauses.english: had its altar and high place broken down by Josiah
clauses.quote: that altar and the high place he brake down

doubts: Marked verses naming Bethel only in lists, borders or as a direction (e.g. GEN 12:8, JOS 18:22, EZR 2:28) were left out.
Hiel the Bethelite (1KI 16:34) concerns a man, not the place, so it was left out.
Jacob's dream at Bethel is described in verses not given (only GEN 28:17-21 are shown), so the line rests on GEN 35.
